schema.description: Create a catalog cost item with an organizationId, a job budget cost item with a jobId, a document costItem with a documentId or an item in a group in any of those contexts with a costGroupId.

A location is required to create a job. A customer is required to create a location. To create a new job for a new customer, create the customer, then location, then the job. Budget line items can be set with the `lineItems` input.

copyCostsFromJobId.description: Copy the budget cost groups and cost items from another job into this job.

copyTasksFromJobId.description: Copy the tasks from another job into this job.

isToDo.description: Choose to create a to-do item. If false, the item is added to the schedule

copyTasksFromJobId.description: Copy the tasks from a job into this task template.

schema.description: Initiate a file upload to JobTread. Use the resulting `createdUploadRequest`.`url`/`method`/`headers` from this call to upload a file and then attach the upload to a JobTread resource with `createFile`. The other option is to provide the `url` to source the uploadRequest if the file is publicly available on the internet.

type.description: Provide either the content type of the file (like 'image/jpeg') or { fromName: '<your file's name>' } to have the file type inferred from the extension. If `url` is provided, this field is optional and the type will be set to the content-type response header.

nextPage.description: A token to retrieve the next page of nodes. If `null`, there are no more nodes.

previousPage.description: A token to retrieve the previous page of nodes. If `null`, there are no previous nodes.
